title: Reading Drill — Studying outdoor chess tables — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying outdoor chess tables — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The park recreation team in Bramley received an old report about pieces being moved by wind on exposed tables. The report compared games interrupted by weather, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the player logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different winds across the square. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed weighted pieces as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
